message:
You know that moment when you’re trying to explain the importance of a go-bag to your kids, and they’re just staring at you like you’ve sprouted a second head? 😅

Recently, we gathered the family to talk about our emergency plans, and let’s just say, the kids were more interested in snacks than survival strategies! 

But as we chatted and tossed ideas around, I saw their eyes light up when we started packing fun things like their favorite books and games into the go-bags. It dawned on me that preparedness doesn’t have to be all serious; it can be a way to bond and create a sense of safety together.

So, maybe next time we can make it a family adventure instead of a lecture! What fun items would you include in your go-bag?
